placements.why: Establishes deployment gating and release controls as an organizational process domain governing staging and production deployment verification.
placements.title: Release progression governed by strict operational verification checkpoints
placements.frame: What verification criteria and gating checkpoints must release artifacts satisfy before progressing across deployment environments?

placements.title: Deployments require cryptographically signed manifests to prevent unsigned artifact promotion
placements.frame: How does mandatory signed manifest verification prevent unsigned build artifacts from reaching staging and production environments?
placements.why: Quinton institutes a mandatory gate requiring signed release manifests for all Meridian deployments across staging and production in response to unsigned artifacts reaching staging.
